components.name: New Conversation Button
components.description: Primary action button to initiate a new session
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; background: #6366f1; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

narrative.overview: Dolphin Buddy provides a calm, focused, dark-themed consumer messaging environment designed specifically for insurance policy guidance.
keyCharacteristics: Rich dark palette (#0f1117 base) engineered for legibility.
Asymmetrical user (#312e81) and agent (#1e2235) chat bubbles.

rules.name: The Indigo Rarity Rule
rules.body: The primary indigo accent (#6366f1) is reserved for explicit interactive triggers and high-value feedback.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is created by step-ups in surface lightness, not multi-layer drop shadows.

dos: Do maintain distinct user (#312e81) vs agent (#1e2235) bubble backgrounds.
Do preserve 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08) borders between dark panels.
donts: Don't use pure light or white backgrounds for card containers.
Don't use heavy drop shadows on chat bubbles.
